Gaps and implications

Your customer journey today: plenty to offer, two gaps in front of it

1

Without a masterclass, there is no way to monetise the 95%* of your audience who aren’t ready for private coaching yet, beyond whoever happens to find a quiz or a post that day.

2

And there is no way to find out who in your audience is actually qualified for it. A quiz taker and someone ready for private coaching look exactly the same until they apply.

No daily front door

New people only arrive when a reel travels

Your reels average 21.7k views, but views come and go with the algorithm. Nothing puts Relationship Renegades in front of new, ready people every single day.

No bridge

Free tools and programs don’t point to private coaching

Someone can take the attachment quiz, join Higher Love and still never see a clear invitation to apply, so the people ready for more stay invisible.

Content-led

Applications depend on you showing up

“Apply” in your bio works when people are already warm. The warming happens through your content, which is capped by the hours the two of you can film.

You have more to offer than most couple coaches. What’s missing is one daily front door that teaches, sells and qualifies at the same time.

*The 95% figure is an industry estimate, not your data.

A free, always-on masterclass, fed by ads, in front of everything you already sell

Everything you’ve built stays. The free class becomes the front door that ads fill every day: it teaches your trigger work, offers the Higher Love Online Program on the thank-you page, and hands the people ready for more an application for Private Coaching.

What a trigger really is

Why your body reacts before your mind catches up, and what the reaction is pointing to.

Script 1 · “The dishes”

Hook (0 to 3s)

Emilio: “How many arguments are really about the dishes?” Rachele: “Almost none.”

Body

“Most recurring fights aren’t about the thing in front of you. They’re about what that moment touches underneath. Once people learn to translate a trigger, the same old argument can turn into a real conversation.”

CTA

“We’re teaching exactly how in a free live masterclass. Replay included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: both on a black set, playful back-and-forth, on-screen text “it’s never about the dishes”.

Script 2 · “Smart people, same pattern”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The most successful people we coach often have the same blind spot.”

Body

“They’ve read every book. They know the language. And in the moment it all disappears, because patterns live in the body, not in the notes app. In one hour we’ll show the five things that actually shift it.”

CTA

“From Trigger to Connection is free and live. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: Rachele to camera, cut to Emilio nodding, deep red lower-third captions.

Script 3 · “Triggers are gifts”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“What if a trigger is the most useful thing that happens in a relationship?”

Body

“A trigger shows exactly where someone needs more safety, more clarity or a better boundary. Most people try to bury it. We teach people how to read it, then use it to come closer instead of drifting apart.”

CTA

“Join our free live masterclass. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: both to camera, on-screen text “trigger = information” in warm white on black.
